name: Motorized Tricycle Yojana
benefit: Under this scheme, beneficiaries will receive a motorized tricycle free of cost to support self-employment and higher education from the Senior Secondary level onwards.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be self-employed or a student pursuing senior higher secondary education. 
1. The applicant must have a 50% or more locomotor disability.
1. The annual family (parents/guardians including applicant's income, if any) income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
1. The applicant's age must be 18 years or older.
1. The applicant must have prior experience in operating a vehicle and hold a valid driving license.
